## How to read this

- **This task is close to trivial for a topology-aware ranker, and that is the finding.** When a fault propagates along the call graph, the root is the one anomalous service every other anomalous service sits above. Generator v1 adds missing telemetry, retry amplification, backpressure, onset skew and coincident anomalies. They pull the no-learning baselines down, not the ranker. The number that matters is the simulation-to-real gap.
- Simulation to real: pending: RCAEval cases converted to Kaal-style events (RP-24 step 4, RP-19).
- Fault type is the harder half. It is not reported on test-ood-fault, whose fault types the head never saw.
